q1_issues.issue: The verb-phrase PP 'as a calendar marker' is attached to the tide entity, whereas the preposition-named-oblique rule puts a PP modifying the clause on the event symbol ((As sk_observe_1 ...)), entity-attached surface prepositions being licensed for position, origin and noun/adjective complements.

q2_gaps: object-predicative 'as'-phrase ('observes X as a calendar marker', 'regards/treats X as Y'): the instruction set covers resultatives and depictives but never an 'as' secondary predicate, so neither its attachment site (event vs object) nor whether the predicative indefinite 'a calendar marker' mints a witness or stays a bare kind is determined
notes: Everything else follows doctrine: 'the Council' is a capitalized bare class word so it stays a common noun with no Name atom, observe takes Agent/Theme, and both compounds carry their head genus with the noun modifiers unexposed.
